name: climate_hardware
pitch_summary: Aerolith is building direct-air carbon capture units powered by renewable electricity. Our proprietary sorbent material captures 1.2kg of CO2 per kWh at $89/ton — half the cost of incumbent DAC technology. We've raised $14M Series A from Breakthrough Energy Ventures and have a pilot installation with Microsoft scheduled for Q3. We project 50,000 tons/year capacity by 2027.
